fields.label: Version
fields.description: Goes up when the text changes after someone has signed it. Signed copies keep the text they signed; they are not asked to sign again.

fields.label: Valid For (Days)
fields.description: 0 = never expires. A range waiver is usually 365.

fields.label: Required
fields.options:
Optional
Required by item
Required for every sale
fields.description: Optional: only offered from the Agreements button. Required by item: a counter sale of an Item (or Item Group) that names this agreement waits for it. Required for every sale: every counter sale waits for it (not an FFL dealer's; a walk-in sale needs a named customer to sign).

fields.label: Signed
fields.options:
Per customer
Each firearm sold
Per document
fields.description: Per customer: one signature covers every visit until it expires. Each firearm sold: a new copy for every gun sold, naming that gun (a no-return agreement). Per document: a copy for one record, signed from that record (a gunsmith work order's intake authorization); never asked for at a sale.

fields.label: Show on Counter Panel
fields.description: Show whether the customer has signed it when they are picked at the counter.

fields.label: Minors Need a Parent or Guardian
fields.description: A participant under 18 cannot sign alone: a parent or guardian signs for them.

fields.label: Agreement Text
fields.description: Placeholders: {{ customer_name }}, {{ first_name }}, {{ date }}, {{ store_name }}, {{ store_address }}, {{ valid_days }}; for Each firearm sold also {{ item_name }}, {{ manufacturer }}, {{ model }}, {{ caliber }}, {{ serial_no }}, {{ price }}; for a gunsmith work order (Per document) also {{ work_order }}, {{ manufacturer }}, {{ model }}, {{ caliber }}, {{ serial_no }}, {{ firearm_type }}, {{ accessories }}, {{ condition }}, {{ work_requested }}, {{ estimated_cost }}, {{ deposit }}, {{ estimated_completion }}.

fields.label: Staff Notes
fields.description: When the counter should ask for it. Never shown to the customer.

name: Agreement Template
description: The text of a waiver or agreement customers sign.
